music found=['calm1', 'calm3'] none=[]
build cues=['dig_grass', 'dig_stone', 'mob_pig', 'random_click', 'random_door_close', 'step_grass', 'step_stone']
build xap=sounds.xap
-- music_out

== music_banks.bat
@echo off
rem Build the XACT audio banks for Xbox 360 (needs the Xbox 360 SDK on PATH).
set XACTBLD="%XEDK%\bin\win32\xactbld3.exe"
%XACTBLD% /L /F /XBOX360 music.xap .
echo Built music.xwb / music.xsb into Content\Audio\

== music_convert.bat
@echo off
rem Decode the matched Minecraft .ogg sources to 16-bit PCM .wav for the XACT banks.
rem Needs ffmpeg on PATH. Source: <RES>
setlocal
set SRC=<RES>
set OUT=wav

ffmpeg -y -i "%SRC%\music\calm1.ogg" -ar 44100 -ac 1 -sample_fmt s16 "%OUT%\calm1.wav"
ffmpeg -y -i "%SRC%\music\calm3.ogg" -ar 44100 -ac 1 -sample_fmt s16 "%OUT%\calm3.wav"

echo Decoded 2 cues to %OUT%\
endlocal

-- build_out
== AUDIO_COVERAGE.md
# AUDIO cues the game needs (8)

Author a .wav per cue under `wav/`, then run `build_banks.bat` (XACTBLD).

- `dig_grass.wav`  <- dig.grass
- `dig_stone.wav`  <- dig.stone
- `mob_pig.wav`  <- mob.pig
- `random_bow.wav`  <- random bow
- `random_click.wav`  <- random.click
- `random_door_close.wav`  <- random.door.close
- `step_grass.wav`  <- step.grass, step.grass
- `step_stone.wav`  <- step.stone

== build_banks.bat
@echo off
rem Build the XACT audio banks for Xbox 360 (needs the Xbox 360 SDK on PATH).
set XACTBLD="%XEDK%\bin\win32\xactbld3.exe"
%XACTBLD% /L /F /XBOX360 sounds.xap .
echo Built sounds.xwb / sounds.xsb into Content\Audio\

== convert_audio.bat
@echo off
rem Decode the matched Minecraft .ogg sources to 16-bit PCM .wav for the XACT banks.
rem Needs ffmpeg on PATH. Source: <RES>
setlocal
set SRC=<RES>
set OUT=wav

ffmpeg -y -i "%SRC%\newsound\step\grass1.ogg" -ar 44100 -ac 1 -sample_fmt s16 "%OUT%\dig_grass.wav"
ffmpeg -y -i "%SRC%\newsound\step\stone1.ogg" -ar 44100 -ac 1 -sample_fmt s16 "%OUT%\dig_stone.wav"
ffmpeg -y -i "%SRC%\newsound\mob\pig1.ogg" -ar 44100 -ac 1 -sample_fmt s16 "%OUT%\mob_pig.wav"
ffmpeg -y -i "%SRC%\newsound\random\click.ogg" -ar 44100 -ac 1 -sample_fmt s16 "%OUT%\random_click.wav"
ffmpeg -y -i "%SRC%\newsound\random\door_close.ogg" -ar 44100 -ac 1 -sample_fmt s16 "%OUT%\random_door_close.wav"
ffmpeg -y -i "%SRC%\newsound\step\grass1.ogg" -ar 44100 -ac 1 -sample_fmt s16 "%OUT%\step_grass.wav"
ffmpeg -y -i "%SRC%\newsound\step\stone1.ogg" -ar 44100 -ac 1 -sample_fmt s16 "%OUT%\step_stone.wav"

echo Decoded 7 cues to %OUT%\
endlocal
